description: Pipeworx original random tables: fetch one built-in table in full — its title, genre, description, and every raw entry (text + weight) — without rolling. Entry text may contain unresolved {{table:<id>}} references; roll_table resolves those at roll time.

table.description: Built-in table id, e.g. "loot", "npc_full", "encounters_fantasy". Call list_random_tables to see every id.

name: get_random_table
